act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In section 263, for the words “Bench of Magistrates”, the words “Bench of Judicial
text:
56. In section 263, for the words “Bench of Magistrates”, the words “Bench of Judicial

Magistrates” and for the words “the State Government”, the words “the High Court” shall be
substituted.
